title.zh: Binance launches 24/7 FX perps with weekend pricing system
title.en: Binance launches 24/7 FX perps with weekend pricing system

current_state.zh: Binance is launching 24/7 foreign exchange perpetual futures, starting with a USDBRL/USDT contract on Sept. 21 that uses a weighted index during FX hours and an orderbook-based EWMA pricing mechanism on weekends and holidays, with up to 100x leverage.
current_state.en: Binance is launching 24/7 foreign exchange perpetual futures, starting with a USDBRL/USDT contract on Sept. 21 that uses a weighted index during FX hours and an orderbook-based EWMA pricing mechanism on weekends and holidays, with up to 100x leverage.
